result.summary: out of scope for INV-1..INV-3/INV-5/INV-9 -- no tenant-data path touched, exact reasoning: this diff (deploy/redeploy-qa.sh, .github/workflows/cd.yml, additive .github/workflows/ci.yml change) is deploy-time CI/CD infrastructure -- a shell script that runs on a QA host over an SSH deploy key restricted by authorized_keys `command=` to itself, and two GitHub Actions workflow files. It creates no Ecto schema/migration, no API route, no response-shaping code, and no lookup-by-ID handler; it never executes inside a request path and never reads or writes tenant business data. INV-4 (secrets by reference only) does apply, since the change adds three new GitHub secret references and a script that handles OIDC client config -- verified below.

invariants_assessed.INV-1: NOT-APPLICABLE -- no Ecto schema, migration, or tenant-scoped table touched.
invariants_assessed.INV-2: NOT-APPLICABLE -- no API response type; S4 not reached by this diff regardless.
invariants_assessed.INV-3: NOT-APPLICABLE -- no tenant-authored script/plugin sandboxing involved.
invariants_assessed.INV-4: APPLIES -- SATISFIED. (a) No secret value is echoed or logged: `grep -n echo deploy/redeploy-qa.sh | grep -iE 'secret|key|password|token|oidc'` returned no matches -- the script's echo statements are progress/status lines only (deploy start, git ref, health-check progress), and VITE_OIDC_AUTHORITY/VITE_OIDC_CLIENT_ID are passed to the throwaway `docker run` build container via `-e` flags, never echoed. (b) No secret is written to a file the repo tracks: qa.env is `source`d (read) from $APP_DIR/qa.env, a host-local file outside the git working tree the script operates in (`git pull` inside $APP_DIR only updates the tracked repo content, not qa.env) -- the script never writes to it. (c) SSH-action secret-reference pattern matches letflow-queue's own proven-safe production cd.yml (read directly at c:\Users\tvolo\dev\ai-dala\letflow-queue\.github\workflows\cd.yml): both use `appleboy/ssh-action@v1` with `host/username/key` sourced from `secrets.*_DEPLOY_HOST/USER/SSH_KEY`, both rely on a `command=`-restricted authorized_keys entry documented inline, both pass a `script:` line that is documentation only since the forced command wins. letflow's cd.yml is structurally identical for the secret-handling steps (it adds an earlier, secret-free artifact-download/gate step ahead of the SSH step, which does not touch secret material). (d) VITE_OIDC_AUTHORITY/VITE_OIDC_CLIENT_ID build args are sourced from `$APP_DIR/qa.env` (host-local, not tracked, not a GitHub Actions secret, not hardcoded in the script body) -- confirmed at redeploy-qa.sh lines 68-78, with `:?` guards that fail loudly rather than default to an empty/hardcoded value. Second grep for hardcoded secret-shaped literals (`grep -niE '(password|secret|client_secret|token)\s*(=|:)\s*"[^"]{8,}"' deploy/ .github/workflows/`) also returned no matches across all three changed files.
